description: Harrisons Malayalam Limited plants and sells tea and rubber in India and internationally. The company operates in three segments: Tea, Rubber, and Others. It offers tea products, custom blended tea, latex, pale latext crepe, and crumb rubber products. In addition, the company cultivates minor crops such as pineapple, cardamom, pepper, and other spices; and produces horticultural crops, including areca nut, banana, cardamom, cocoa, coffee, coconut, pepper, and vanilla, as well as of organic tea and spices. Harrisons Malayalam Limited was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Kochi, India.
